suppress.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-15. CVE-2025-21199 applies to Microsoft Azure Agent Installer products under the CPE family cpe:2.3:a:microsoft:azure_agent:* and the NVD affected-software entries are for the "backup" and "site_recovery" products. This repo contains the Java libraries com.microsoft.azure:applicationinsights-core and com.microsoft.azure:applicationinsights-web, which are being mapped to the generic azure_agent CPE by Dependency-Check. Keep this suppression only for that false-positive CPE match.

Reviewed 2026-08-10. CVE-2025-7962 is reported against org.eclipse.angus:angus-activation:2.0.3 through the generic cpe:2.3:a:eclipse:angus_mail CPE. This service does not use Angus Mail APIs. The flagged artifact is the Activation implementation pulled transitively via JAXB/Hibernate/common-lib rather than direct mail handling. Keep this suppression scoped to angus-activation 2.0.3 and revisit when a stable non-vulnerable replacement is available through the managed dependency chain.

Reviewed 2026-07-23. CVE-2026-44891, CVE-2026-55831, and CVE-2026-55833 apply to Netty versions before 4.1.136.Final and 4.2.16.Final. This repo now imports io.netty:netty-bom 4.2.16.Final in build.gradle, which is the fixed 4.2.x release according to the CVE descriptions and Netty release notes. Dependency-Check is still reporting these CVEs because the current NVD CPE configuration includes 4.2.16. Keep this suppression only for the already-fixed Netty 4.2.16.Final artifacts until NVD/Dependency-Check metadata catches up or a newer fixed 4.2.x release is available.

Reviewed 2026-11-05. CVE-2026-33117 applies to com.azure:azure-security-keyvault-keys local cryptographic verification and is fixed in azure-security-keyvault-keys 4.10.6. This repo does not depend on azure-security-keyvault-keys; it uses Azure Blob Storage via BlobServiceClientBuilder, BlobContainerClient, and BlobClient. Keep this suppression only for false-positive generic Azure SDK mappings against the Blob Storage dependency chain used by this service. Match these named artifacts across versions so routine Blob upgrades do not reopen this false positive. Remove it if Dependency-Check corrects the mapping; the CVE-specific suppression still expires on 2026-12-15.
